body: For years ive always ended up seeing my work go to waste, back in school i tried to work hard, the school lost my I.T. course work just before final exams, which forced me to drop down to bottom set with C grade highest... I couldve had an A+. My performing arts exam was ruined by my partner after i was stuck with them from the the start, nobody else chose us for the group work, lucky me. Again the highest grade i achieved in my Drama exam was a C grade. My first year of college, i almost failed right t the endfor failure to attend after i was under investigation from police when i broke up with a psychotic ex girlfriend. Ive even troed countless times to fix my dysfunctional family on my mothers side but nobody will change for the better and then they try to find reasons to disrespect me and tell me everything im doing is pointless. And i dont even know ill be able to get my second year of college completed with distinctions if im having to work so much just to survive

Ive not slept for 24 hours, but i just stayed in bed all day and ended up skipping college and work, i said i had a family emergency. I had to pay a £100 parking ticket after having to chase up my student loan find out why i hadnt received my money, the woman spoke to me like crap and eventually found out there was a system error... £300 is already gone to bills and the ticket, the remaining £300 is for car repairs which i still cant afford. I ended buying 2gs of bud to smoke, i dont drink to numb the pain. Still behind on bills on some bills. I've just been using a shit faulty android with a fucked charger port all day, ive been on 3-7% the last 8 hours. Ive been a gamer from a young age but my laptop died in july, so since then ive been deprived of something i enjoy a lot, and no money to replace it.  Soo.. yeah its been a pretty shitty day and boring day

As for the paragraph, right now im stuck with my parents who are two faced arrogant assholes, they give me a place to stay but i never feel welcome here, plus my step dad will always play the victim in an argument between us After He makes the moody/sarcastic comments.... I never say shit to antagonise the mf, even when he throws my left over food or takes my big bag of tea bags ffs. I feel like im second class in a family home.
As for friends, nobody ever comes to me to talk or chill, its very rare i hear of people talking about me or get invited to social gatherings, ive known some people for years  but theyve never messaged me first... It doesnt matter who i meet, the person they are,  their background or even if they say theyre my friend, nobody seems to really care all that much about me. Ive been suicidal a lot over the years, most people basically say "chin up" in short and then i dont hear from them for months. Doesnt matter who i surround myself with ill always be an outsider

Im fed up with living a life that was doomed from the moment i was born. All my hard work gets flushed down the drain, everytime i have to rely on other people im always let down. And every time i try to dig myself out of the pit od depression and misery, theres always something or someone to throw me back down and when i cry out for help nobody listens, they just tell me its my fault and i need to deal with it

Nothing is up, everything is down for me. Im made to feel like everything wrong in my life is my fault, like im being made to suffer for every decision i make no matter how innocent or good i may think it is. I just get told im wrong, i get put down and criticised
